annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC TR 24028:2020 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Overview of trustworthiness in artificial intelligence
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC TR 24028:2020 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Overview of trustworthiness in artificial intelligence
annotation.summary_en: ISO store catalogue page for ISO/IEC TR 24028:2020, a technical report surveying trustworthiness in AI systems: transparency, explainability, controllability, engineering pitfalls, threats and mitigations, and approaches to availability, resiliency, reliability, safety, security and privacy. Published May 2020 by JTC 1/SC 42. Metadata only.
key_provisions_or_claims: Surveys approaches to establish trust in AI via transparency, explainability and controllability
Describes engineering pitfalls, threats, risks and mitigation techniques for AI systems
Covers assessing availability, resiliency, reliability, accuracy, safety, security and privacy
Specifying levels of trustworthiness is out of scope
Published May 2020, 43 pages, by ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42
